data.title: 埃塔 · 深夜地板上的宵夜
data.description: 实验间隙，埃塔抱着一瓶用试剂瓶装的热牛奶坐在实验室地板上。宽松的睡衣滑下一边肩头，她也不在意，含着吸管望着培养舱发呆——下一个实验的灵感，通常在这个时候敲门。
data.location: 阴影庭园地下实验室·深夜
data.action: 坐在地板上抱着试剂瓶喝热牛奶，睡衣滑肩，望着培养舱发呆
data.lighting: single desk lamp and the faint glow of a culture tank
data.promptProse: On the lab floor at midnight, adult Eta sips warm milk from a reagent bottle, oversized pajamas slipping off one shoulder, staring blankly at the culture tank as ideas gather.
data.animaCaption: Milk in a reagent bottle, pajamas on the floor — Eta's midnight brainstorming position.
